title: Loving Christmas
overview: Ashley Mackenzie has always been the preeminent “Christmas Queen” in town. From making hand-crafted  decorations for the office to hosting the town’s annual Christmas sweater competition, she loves everything about the holiday. That is, until she meets her match in Ben Williams, a devilishly handsome new guy in town, who loves Christmas just as much as she does – and unwittingly begins to steal her thunder.
